title: Ground Fee by Parcel Contents, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
**Rate rule.** The ground fee owed for a self-pay shipment that went out by ground in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program is:

| Contents of the shipment | Ground fee owed |
|---|---|
| filters only | 3.95 |
| no mask or cushion line, and an item other than filters | 4.95 |
| a mask or cushion line | no parcel rate under this rule |

## Terms

- **Filters:** disposable filters (A7038) and non-disposable filters (A7039). A shipment of filters only has every one of its item lines a filter line.
- **Mask or cushion line:** a line of a full face mask (A7030), a nasal mask or pillows interface (A7034), a full face mask cushion (A7031), a nasal mask cushion (A7032) or a nasal pillows pair (A7033).

## Examples (hypothetical shipments)

- Disposable filters and a non-disposable filter: filters only, 3.95.
- Disposable filters and headgear: no mask or cushion line and an item other than filters, 4.95.
- Standard tubing alone: 4.95.
- Nasal cushions and filters: holds a cushion line, no parcel rate under this rule.
